deadlines.label: Data Protection Board detailed report (readiness timer)

S1.name: Volume spike
S1.description: 15-min downloads divided by max(user p95, team p95, baseline_floor). PRESIGN over presign_count_threshold counts as downloads.

S2.name: Slow leak
S2.description: Daily downloads exceed multiple of daily average and minimum count; only applies if higher than S1.

S3.name: Privileged role without approval
S3.description: Emergency role assumed with no covering approval, or service account outside its job window.

S4.name: External upload to non-allowlisted destination
S4.description: UPLOAD_EXTERNAL: large or close to KYC downloads scores high, otherwise low.

S5.name: Risky login
S5.description: New device, MFA fatigue, or impossible travel. Points are summed and capped at max_points.

S6.name: Off-hours activity
S6.description: Activity outside the user's usual hours by more than grace_hours.

S7.name: Unassigned customer access
S7.description: Customers not assigned to the user or their partner, within the window.

S8.name: Logging tampered
S8.description: StopLogging, DeleteTrail or bucket logging disabled. Instant maximum score.

S9.name: Purpose mismatch
S9.description: KYC or PII read for a purpose the customer has not consented to.

S10.name: Abnormal disbursement
S10.description: DISBURSE to a recently changed bank account and/or amount far above user's p95.

S11.name: Sensitive resource misconfigured
S11.description: Config non-compliant resource; KYC data class scores higher.

E1.name: Scheduled job
E1.description: Scheduled job inside its window caps the score.

E2.name: Approved ticket
E2.description: Approved ticket caps the score; void if files exceed the ticket by more than overage_tolerance_pct (then add overage_points).

E3.name: Self-approval ignored
E3.description: An approval created by the actor being scored is ignored.
